# ankra_cluster_access_policy (Data Source)

The organisation's Kubernetes access policy: the limits every kubectl access grant through the cluster gateway is held to, an administrator's included. The counterpart of `ankra org access-policy get`. Reading it needs `kube_access.manage`, `kube_access.policy` or `kube_access.elevate`, and the cluster gateway must be enabled.

This is read-only on purpose. Changing the policy needs `kube_access.policy`, a human-only permission that no token carries unless it names it, and the platform mints no API token that can name it; so a Terraform write could never succeed. Propose a change with `ankra org access-policy set` and have an organisation owner or admin apply it, signed in. Use this data source to check the policy (for example with a `check` block or a precondition on `ankra_cluster_access_grant`) or to size grant lifetimes inside it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_access_policy" "this" {}

# Keep the policy honest: nobody may hold standing cluster-admin.
check "cluster_access_ceiling" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.ankra_cluster_access_policy.this.is_configured && data.ankra_cluster_access_policy.this.max_grant_role != "cluster-admin"
    error_message = "The organisation's cluster access policy still allows cluster-admin grants. Propose a lower ceiling with `ankra org access-policy set --max-role edit`."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `creator_grant_role` (String) What whoever creates or imports a cluster gets on it: `none`, `view`, `edit`, `admin` or `cluster-admin`.
- `elevated_max_ttl_seconds` (Number) How long a grant above `view` may last, in seconds; null when the policy sets no limit (break-glass elevation is then still bounded to 4 hours).
- `id` (String) Always `cluster_access_policy`.
- `is_configured` (Boolean) Whether the organisation has set a policy. While it is `false` the platform defaults below apply: the creator of a cluster gets `cluster-admin` on it and anyone can be given any access.
- `max_grant_role` (String) The ceiling: the most access anyone can be given, `view`, `edit`, `admin` or `cluster-admin`.
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation the policy belongs to.
- `organisation_name` (String) Name of that organisation.
- `require_reason_from_role` (String) The lowest role whose grants need a reason; null when only break-glass elevation needs one.
